packageRules.description: The Google dependency pins in the root Package.swift are generated from Podfile.lock by scripts/update_package_dependencies.rb. Bumping them here either reverts on the next release build or breaks the version range the ML Kit pods were built against (e.g. GTMSessionFetcher is pinned < 4.0).
Ruby is pinned to 3.x on purpose: Ruby 4.0 broke CocoaPods on the macOS runners (regression in PR #86).
